channel.title: Midnight blog - en - Last 7 days
channel.description: 记录软件从需求、架构设计、开发、测试到发布、运维与持续改进的工程实践，讨论具体约束、方案取舍和验证方法。AI 是工具链的一部分。 | Language: en | Range: Last 7 days

item.title: How can a highlighted suggestion leave the search input ready for typing?
item.description: Separate DOM input focus, active suggestions, and commit in an editable combobox, then check the reference when suggestions refresh.

item.title: Why can’t the next CMake command read a file just scheduled by file(GENERATE)?
item.description: Compare file reads during configuration and after generation, including a stale output from the previous run.

item.title: Why did a translation animation hide the component’s existing translateX?
item.description: Compare replace and add at a fixed keyframe sample, then check how a static translation participates in the result.

item.title: Why did TreeWalker lose the children of a wrapper?
item.description: Use one DOM tree to compare TreeWalker SKIP, REJECT, and their effect on descendant visits.

item.title: Every Git commit ID changed. Which patch actually changed?
item.description: Compare two fixed Git ranges to distinguish a new commit identity from a changed patch.

item.title: Why didn’t a shared Make rule pick prerequisites for each target?
item.description: Use GNU Make secondary expansion to give two targets different prerequisites and verify an incremental rebuild.

item.title: Why do buffered Go CSV rows end up identical?
item.description: Use two Go CSV rows to distinguish immediate field reads from a retained slice that may be reused.

item.title: Why does new FormData fire formdata without submitting the form?
item.description: Use a form preview to distinguish entry construction, synchronous listeners, control values, and submission.

item.title: Does HTTP 416 plus the current length mean the download is complete?
item.description: Use two equal-length files to interpret the current representation length in HTTP 416 and test what evidence a download still needs.

item.title: Can an API still work after a Deprecation response header?
item.description: Read deprecation and expected retirement dates from an old endpoint that still returns 200, then separate response handling from migration planning.

item.title: Why did two PostgreSQL rows turn into one JSONB key?
item.description: Use two groups of settings to distinguish PostgreSQL JSONB aggregation order, duplicate rejection, and strict mode.

item.title: Why did Prometheus return a p75 and report repaired buckets?

item.title: Why can a valid outer Pydantic model contain an invalid nested field?
item.description: Trace three executed Pydantic inputs through default reuse, dictionary validation, and instance revalidation.

item.title: Why can two pytest files with the same name collide during collection?
item.description: Compare pytest’s default import mode with importlib mode for same-named tests in non-package directories.

item.title: Why does an asyncio task read the old ContextVar value?
item.description: Use an executed event-gated fixture to separate asyncio task creation, context copying, and the later read.

item.title: Why are the resources still open after ExitStack exits?
item.description: Trace partial acquisition failure and successful callback transfer in an executed ExitStack fixture.

item.title: Why is set equality too weak for an order-insensitive test?
item.description: Use a standard-library fixture to distinguish valid reordering from a missing or replaced duplicate.

item.title: Why can ResizeObserver report a border box but stay silent when padding changes?
item.description: Use two subscriptions on one element to separate the ResizeObserver trigger from the sizes in its entry.

item.title: Why does a SQLite schema diff miss a generated column?
item.description: Use a tested SQLite fixture to distinguish generated values from two different schema inventories.

item.title: Why doesn’t RuntimeMaxSec stop a stuck systemd oneshot?
item.description: Use three systemd service configurations to separate activation timeout from a limit on active runtime.

item.title: Can a successful cross-region list with unreachable entries be treated as complete?
item.description: Use two cross-region pages to separate pagination completion from source coverage under AIP-217.

item.title: Which ARIA relation preserves a table in a chart’s long description?
item.description: Use a quarterly chart, visible table, and ordinary link to compare a structured extended description with a flat accessible description.

item.title: How should a virtual list expose positions when it renders only three items?
item.description: Compare two three-row windows within a 60-item set to check true positions, set size, and the unknown-size case.

item.title: Does Array.fromAsync pull the next item while a mapper is pending?
item.description: Use controlled gates to separate the next asynchronous pull, mapper scheduling, and output order.

item.title: Why does a deferred CMake call read a value set later?
item.description: Compare late evaluation and a captured value in a CMake configure run.

item.title: Can Docker reuse a copy layer after the base changes?
item.description: Keep an artifact constant and compare conventional Docker COPY with an independent COPY --link layer.

item.title: Why does a rewritten upstream put one extra commit in my topic range?
item.description: Use a small Git graph and two local tracking refs to verify the replay range after an upstream rewrite.

item.title: Why does errors.Unwrap return nil for a Go errors.Join value?
item.description: Use a joined error and an outer wrapper to distinguish Go’s one-step Unwrap from matching through an error tree.

item.title: Why can a Go recorder show a header that Result omits?
item.description: Use two handler paths to separate the mutable Go recorder headers from the snapshot in Result.

item.title: Why does HTTP 103 Early Hints not establish request success?

item.title: Why can an empty HTTP 205 reset the data-entry view?
item.description: Compare 204, 205, and a failure with a nonempty default category to decide when a data-entry view should reset.

item.title: Why does Intl.Segmenter still overcount words at word granularity?
item.description: Compare all word-granularity segments with the isWordLike count, then check positions against the original string.

item.title: Why can a failed Pod leave a Job’s retry budget untouched?
item.description: Trace three failed Pod inputs through a Job’s disruption rule, exit-code rule, and default handling.

item.title: Why does array_agg return {NULL} for a parent with no children?

item.title: Why do two blank CSV fields import as different PostgreSQL values?
item.description: Use three PostgreSQL CSV rows to distinguish a missing value, empty text, and a single space.

item.title: Why did a green pytest --lf run skip my new test?
item.description: Reproduce pytest’s cached failure selection and compare a green rerun with the full test set.

item.title: Why does Inexact reject 1.234 but accept 1.230?
item.description: Use three executed Python Decimal inputs to separate a quantization signal from a rule about how a reading is written.

item.title: Why did assertLogs pass when my normal handler saw nothing?
item.description: Use an executed unittest fixture to distinguish temporary capture from normal handler delivery in CPython.

item.title: Why did SQLite put quotes around an array inside JSON?
item.description: Trace six verified SQLite path types to see when an array is embedded and when it becomes a string.

item.title: Why did a runtime file disappear after systemd restarted the service?
item.description: Compare systemd runtime-directory cleanup across a direct restart and an explicit stop.

item.title: Should a client stop when a page is empty but has a next_page_token?
item.description: Reproduce dropped results with three catalog replies and use the continuation token as the end signal under AIP-158.

item.title: Why does Alertmanager choose one receiver when two routes match?
item.description: Trace four label sets through ordered child routes and see when Alertmanager falls back to the root receiver.

item.title: Why does navigation use aria-current while tabs use aria-selected?
item.description: Follow navigation and manual tabs in notification settings to check current page, tab selection, and keyboard focus separately.

item.title: Why does CMake reuse output after an input the generator read changes?
item.description: Compare two Ninja builds that run the same generator and track different sets of input dependencies.

item.title: Why did text wrap when the panel kept its width?
item.description: Keep a 320px border box fixed and compare usable width with auto and stable under classic and overlay scrollbars.

item.title: Why can moving the same custom element run its setup again?
item.description: Compare lifecycle callbacks when reordering native custom elements with insertBefore and moveBefore, then check the rule for first insertion.

item.title: What does Last-Event-ID tell an SSE server after reconnect?
item.description: Follow two notifications with an inherited ID in a loopback fixture, then separate the EventSource reconnect cursor from application acknowledgment.

item.title: Why does git log --first-parent omit commits that were merged?
item.description: Compare two logs from a pinned merge tip and check feature ancestry independently.

item.title: Why does Go QueryRowContext return a Row before Scan reports an error?
item.description: Use four test-driver inputs to trace the boundaries of a Go query Row, Row.Err, and Scan.

item.title: Why can a request with Prefer: return=minimal still return JSON?
item.description: Check two valid 201 replies to the same create request and handle response content and preference disclosure under the endpoint contract.

item.title: Why is a Ready Pod not yet counted as available?
item.description: Trace an interrupted readiness interval and compare it with a zero-second control to explain Deployment availability.

item.title: Why can PostgreSQL select a name grouped only by primary key?
item.description: Compare primary-key and unique-key grouping in PostgreSQL, then use two customers with the same name to verify the report grain.

item.title: Why can a literal qualify for a partial index while a bound status cannot?
item.description: Compare generic and custom PostgreSQL plans to tell partial-index eligibility from the path the planner actually chooses.

item.title: Who can settle a promise created with withResolvers?
item.description: A one-shot import receipt separates waiting from settlement and checks two readers, duplicate notifications, and rejection with deterministic assertions.

item.title: Why does heapq compare dictionaries when priorities tie?
item.description: Compare two-field heap entries with entries carrying a counter, using an unexecuted standard-library fixture for tie order and re-addition policy.

item.title: Where does a Redis task go if its worker crashes after claiming it?
item.description: Trace the ready and processing lists through a Redis claim, worker interruption, and acknowledgment.

item.title: Why did ZADD GT add a new leaderboard member?
item.description: Use independent membership and score checks to explain Redis ZADD GT, XX, and the behavior of a missing leaderboard key.

item.title: Can you reuse acceptance evidence when the requirement wording stays the same?
item.description: Use a stockroom inventory example to decide which acceptance evidence can carry forward, which checks to repeat, and how to retain the link between requirements, builds, settings and field tasks.

item.title: Why does SQLite reject ORDER BY lower(name) after UNION ALL?
item.description: Trace SQLite compound sort terms to result columns using three executed queries and an alias-resolution follow-up.

item.title: Why can systemctl reload return before new settings take effect?
item.description: Compare a signal-only reload with a notification-based reload and check the active configuration generation.

item.title: AbortSignal.any reasons: DOM rules and a Node v24.21.0 comparison
item.description: Separate the DOM reason-selection rules, a synchronous recorder and local Node subscription/read-condition observations.

item.title: Why can a normal CMake reference stay old after the cache changes?
item.description: Separate normal-variable lookup from cache writes, empty bindings, unset, and CMP0126 instead of diagnosing every old value as stale cache.

item.title: Inspect display:contents through layout, selectors and events
item.description: Inspect grid layout, DOM child selectors and bubbling separately, then add generated content and accessibility limits as distinct conditions.

item.title: Test a Dockerfile path contract with two controlled base directories
item.description: Use two controlled base stages and four expected paths to distinguish WORKDIR inheritance, absolute anchors, and runtime -w overrides.

item.title: Read composedPath with matching open and closed examples
item.description: Use matched open and closed examples to separate retargeting, visible paths and boundary crossing, then account for dispatch cleanup.

item.title: Fix a make cd by choosing the scope of shared shell state
item.description: Compare local cd && with file-wide .ONESHELL through isolated Makefiles, failure propagation, and interpreter-prefix conditions.

item.title: A range contains cde. Why does Repr-Digest still cover abcdef?
item.description: Compare a single identity-coded range with the full selected representation using fixed byte oracles, retaining coding and trust boundaries.

item.title: Why does a formatter still use 12-hour time after requesting h23?
item.description: Trace merged options, locale hc preferences and hour12 precedence using a fixed UTC instant and local effective-option output.

item.title: Why can every pass without checking a single input?
item.description: Separate empty collections, missing slots and invalid values with five inputs and observed local callback counts.

item.title: Trace the initial accumulator in four reduce calls
item.description: Inspect accumulator initialization through omitted arguments, explicit undefined, singleton objects and an observed negative maximum case.

item.title: Why does /~01 not select the slash-named member?
item.description: Resolve JSON Pointer tokens once in the required order, then test root, empty-name members, arrays, and fragment representations by target identity.

item.title: An existing job.lock does not mean Linux flock is still held
item.description: Trace Linux local-filesystem flock through duplicate references, independent opens, last close, and child inheritance without certifying network storage.

item.title: Why does deleting an author try to null tenant_id too?
item.description: Use PostgreSQL18 ON DELETE SET NULL column subsets while preserving post and tenant identities, including a same-numbered author in another tenant.

item.title: Why can daily PostgreSQL series points be 25 hours apart?
item.description: Compare calendar-day and 24-hour series across a documented historical transition using separate local-date and UTC-time oracles.

item.title: Why does an Index Only Scan still fetch heap rows?
item.description: Separate index coverage from snapshot visibility before changing INCLUDE columns or interpreting heap-fetch counts.

item.title: Why is the SQL ratio zero after casting it to numeric?
item.description: Move conversion before integer division, then verify negative values, zero denominators, units, and bound parameter types.

item.title: Why can lag(value, 1, 0) still return NULL?
item.description: Compare missing predecessors, existing null readings, and COALESCE placement while keeping predecessor identity and every original row.

item.title: Why does or vector(0) still leave a missing PromQL instance absent?
item.description: Trace PromQL left-preferred union, unlabeled vector(0), and the on() control through a complete unexecuted fixture for labeled display defaults.

item.title: Why did HSET return 0 after updating the value?
item.description: Keep HSET’s count of added fields separate from write errors, final values, and the meaning of a retry after a lost reply.

item.title: Sprint Review does not replace Done or act as a release gate
item.description: Separate Done, Review and delivery with three report states, including the rule for unfinished work and shared organizational standards.

item.title: Why a tolerated experimental matrix still has cancelled siblings
item.description: Identify the failed member before interpreting job tolerance and fail-fast. A complete two-input workflow retains queued-job and scheduling boundaries.

item.title: A second CSP header cannot override the first one
item.description: Two enforced policies constrain each request. A local three-endpoint fixture separates the rejecting policy, CORS, delivery ownership and meta timing.

item.title: Two cards, three Grid columns: why does an empty column keep its space?
item.description: Calculate empty-track behavior in a 900px grid with 20px gaps, then use four cards, spanning and indefinite sizing to define the choice.

item.title: Why can IME text still change after beforeinput.preventDefault()?
item.description: Use the Input Events Level 2 Working Draft to distinguish ordinary edits from IME composition, with a textarea trace, post-edit validation and bounded correction.

item.title: Why does adding two pixels per frame make your animation faster on another screen?
item.description: Use a one-second, 240px teaching animation to explain timestamp progress, first-frame baselines, cancellation, hidden time and shared animation clocks.

item.title: Three table rows, one Gherkin scenario: where did the other runs go?
item.description: Separate Examples expansion from a step Data Table using complete permission features, independent outcomes and multi-section counting; distinguish selection, matching and assertions.

item.title: Adding --remote changes the source of the submodule commit
item.description: Separate the parent index gitlink, committed tree, child HEAD and remote candidate with a complete A/B fixture and a staged-upgrade counterexample.

item.title: Tab still reaches the background? Define the inert region around your overlay
item.description: Explain inert through flat-tree scope, the native modal-dialog exception and concurrent blocking ownership, using a complete unexecuted teaching page.

item.title: Why does a JSON replacer see different fields? Check toJSON first
item.description: Trace toJSON before the function replacer, root wrapping and holder identity, with complete unexecuted probes for original and replacement entry stages.

item.title: Reject duplicate JSON names before Python builds a dict
item.description: Reject repeated JSON member names before Python constructs a dict, with RFC qualification, nested scope and decoded escape-equivalence checks.

item.title: Why did a null-valued Merge Patch delete the member?
item.description: Trace RFC 7396 member removal, recursive objects, whole-array replacement and root null, including the trade-off for explicit null data.

item.title: Position reached 103. Why is Kafka processing still unfinished?
item.description: Trace one partition across polling, external processing and committed recovery, including early-commit skips, replay windows and concurrent gaps.

item.title: Why does an OpenAPI array become repeated query keys instead of commas?
item.description: Compare form arrays as commas or repeated keys with a complete OpenAPI parameter contract, parser failure cases and limits for nested deepObject values.

item.title: Why did the customer disappear from a latest-order query?
item.description: Use a complete latest-order fixture to separate LATERAL references from row preservation, including empty children, ties and aggregate cardinality.

item.title: An instant query need not return old samples for five minutes
item.description: Two paper timelines distinguish lookback selection from stale termination, with exporter timestamp, sample-age and query-step conditions.

item.title: Why did the next assertion inside a failing subTest not run?
item.description: Trace the skipped tail and continuation point of a failed subTest, retain the inner failure, and change the stopping condition in a separate fail-fast comparison.

item.title: Why did other Redis writes survive an EXEC WRONGTYPE error?
item.description: Separate Redis queue-time errors, execution-time WRONGTYPE and WATCH aborts, using individual replies and final key state to assess retries.

item.title: Why did an outer rollback undo a successful SQLite RELEASE?
item.description: Compare inner and outermost SQLite savepoint release, then trace transaction ownership, final rollback and the marker retained by ROLLBACK TO.

item.title: Why did a SQLite ANY column lose the leading zeroes?
item.description: Compare numeric text in ordinary and STRICT ANY columns, inspect storage class and spelling, and distinguish new-input preservation from historical identity recovery.

item.title: Why ./worker fails despite a configured WorkingDirectory
item.description: Separate the ExecStart executable token from process cwd with a complete unit and file-reading fixture, including lookup and interpreter-argument boundaries.

item.title: Is a default-filled field in an old Avro event an original fact?
item.description: Compare identical old bytes under different defaults and separately encoded EUR data to distinguish reader interpretation from recorded values.

item.title: Can a positive Bloom filter result reject a username?
item.description: Use expected-count tables and a deterministic collision model to decide when probabilistic positives need authoritative verification.

item.title: Why does nth-child striping break after rows are hidden?
item.description: Hidden rows can remain in structural indexing. A complete four-row fixture compares external filtering with nth-child’s of subset, including exact memberships, state changes and unsupported syntax.

item.title: Cleanup ran, so why does the old widget still receive events?
item.description: Listener removal requires the correct target, event type, callback identity and capture value. A complete counting probe distinguishes mismatches and signal cleanup across remounts.

item.title: Why does another listener on the same button survive stopPropagation?
item.description: The current same-target listener sequence differs from later propagation. Three expected custom-event traces separate immediate stopping, cancellation and completed side effects.

item.title: Stop when p drops below .05: what happened to the original guarantee?
item.description: A single-look cutoff does not automatically control stopping at any significant look. An exact two-look teaching example distinguishes fixed horizons, sequential inference and safety stops.

item.title: Conversion rose, but why did a 50/50 test become 60/40?
item.description: When analyzed group counts disagree with planned allocation, reconcile assignment, exposure and inclusion before interpreting lift. A hypothetical ledger separates SRM detection, diagnosis and the benefit decision.

item.title: A Go parent test function can return before its test tree finishes
item.description: Distinguish parent-function return from test-tree completion with complete expected-failure and expected-success controls, including Setenv’s process-wide limit.

item.title: Why can a preview escape while its iframe still has sandbox?
item.description: An unexecuted two-file fixture compares same-origin iframe permissions, sandbox removal, navigation timing and dedicated hosting for untrusted HTML.

item.title: Why did JSON Patch delete B and E when B and D were selected?
item.description: Trace positional deletion on a five-item list and distinguish descending indices, tests, version conditions and stable identity.

item.title: After rotation leaves an empty log, check which file the writer still holds
item.description: Use a local file-sequence exercise to explain retained writers and the copytruncate loss window, without presenting it as a real logrotate run.

item.title: Why revoke the new refresh token when the old one is already invalid?
item.description: Separate old-token rejection from active-token revocation with a three-step state exercise, including concurrent refresh, lost responses and access-token limits.

item.title: A removed set member returns: should a concurrent add win?
item.description: Trace two addition identities in a complete teaching model and distinguish shared-label convergence from revocation policy.

item.title: Does a vanished collation warning mean old indexes are repaired?
item.description: Use a two-index ledger and read-only catalog queries to distinguish a vanished warning, restored dependencies and workload validation.

item.title: Why can SELECT still read old prices after a write CTE?
item.description: Use complete temporary-table SQL to compare old base values, new returned values and audit inputs, including overlapping-write limits.

item.title: Why did setting quota to zero have no effect? Check Protobuf presence
item.description: Compare explicit presence, implicit merging and older reserialization across unchanged, zero and nonzero quota updates.

item.title: Why does a React editor keep the previous record’s draft?
item.description: Changing record props need not reset an editor at the same tree position. A complete editor and A/B/A expectations explain keyed subtree recreation, draft retention and separate backend work.

item.title: An expired start-limit window does not schedule a systemd retry
item.description: Explain restart policy, start-rate limits and new triggers with a bounded three-start unit, separating counter reset, process launch and business readiness.

item.title: Connect HTTP 425 to business side effects before enabling TLS 0-RTT
item.description: Connect TLS early-data rejection, HTTP 425 retry conditions and independent business-state readings. The POST ledger is an isolated negative rejection test.

item.title: Was the new design faster, or had users just learned the task?
item.description: Faster second attempts may reflect learning rather than a better interface. A four-sequence plan for two designs and two materials makes order checkable and identifies when separate participants are preferable.

item.title: Separate resource identity from its access URL
item.description: Distinguish local IDs, relative and full resource names, and access URIs under Google AIP-122, using parent collisions, declared version mappings and caller-dependent aliases.

item.title: Before applying late data, choose replacement totals or deltas
item.description: Work through five, twelve and an incorrect seventeen to define late-data corrections in Apache Beam event-time windows, separating replacement totals, additive contributions and audited backfills.

item.title: Why does a newly opened tab miss an earlier BroadcastChannel message?
item.description: Explain late subscription and sender exclusion through the recipient-selection algorithm, then separate change notifications from the source of current state.

item.title: Choosing open, closed or hybrid sorting for a help centre
item.description: Use six help-content cards to compare the evidence from open, closed and hybrid sorts, then carry disputed groupings into finding tasks.

item.title: CONFIGURE_DEPENDS adds rechecks without removing the source-list tradeoff
item.description: Compare explicit lists, plain GLOB and CONFIGURE_DEPENDS to inspect new-source membership, generator support and unintended matches.

item.title: Use order-only prerequisites to create directories without invalidating files
item.description: Directory preparation and target invalidation are separate requirements. Compare complete rules while checking that real input updates still rebuild the report.

item.title: Why an Iceberg file absent from the latest snapshot may still be needed
item.description: Use a two-snapshot reference graph to distinguish Iceberg snapshot expiration from orphan removal, accounting for retained history, active writers and path representations.

item.title: Choose log timestamps separately for incident and collection questions
item.description: Timestamp and ObservedTimestamp describe source events and collection observations. Three complete records show fallback selection, missing provenance and clock-difference limits.

item.title: Validate logical migration through rows, schema, and the next write
item.description: PostgreSQL 18 logical replication does not cover DDL, sequence state or large objects. A complete read-only inventory and independent numeric cases separate read-subscriber evidence from write-cutover readiness.

item.title: Why can a PromQL result of zero still activate an alert?
item.description: Bool comparisons retain zero-valued elements, while alerts activate by result presence. Two targets distinguish filtering, waiting periods and missing data.

item.title: Why can autospec execute a real property before the test calls it?
item.description: Autospec can read real attributes while constructing a spec. A local sentinel and a narrow interface distinguish inspection, signature checks and real behavior.

item.title: A pilot survey does not replace cognitive pretesting
item.description: Use five synthetic ledger entries to compare cognitive probes and a field pilot, separating complete answers from shared meaning and record availability.

item.title: RabbitMQ acknowledged the publish. Why is the queue empty?
item.description: Separate unroutable returns, publisher confirms and unknown outcomes under RabbitMQ 4.1 AMQP 0-9-1, using complete local traces that preserve a return after a later ACK.

item.title: Choose the out-of-memory outcome before mixing cache and authoritative state
item.description: Choose where Redis caches and authoritative records belong by their eviction or write-rejection consequences, with explicit allkeys, volatile and noeviction eligibility examples.

item.title: Record Saga compensation outcomes beyond the failure arrow
item.description: Define uncertain compensation, authoritative lookup and manual intervention through Saga traces involving a confirmed reservation, rejected payment and timed-out release.

item.title: Design an advisory capacity check for an offline package
item.description: Use a read-only classifier and four independent expected cases to separate estimated capacity, actual writes and persistence permission.

item.title: Why does ExecCondition exit 1 skip a service without marking it failed?
item.description: ExecCondition distinguishes continuing, skipping and failure. A complete teaching unit retains the effects of SuccessExitStatus and ExecStopPost.

item.title: Preserve the name and define its Unicode comparison key separately
item.description: Preserve original names and derive NFC comparison keys, using five independent expectations to examine compatibility folding, collisions and concatenation.

item.title: Plan captions for speech, speakers and meaningful sounds
item.description: Use an eight-second synthetic script and three expected cues to review speech, speakers, an error tone and the text-alternative exception.

item.title: Tab only indents. How can a keyboard user leave the editor?
item.description: Use a complete local inline-editor fixture to define an Escape handoff, subsequent navigation and the limits of keyboard-exit validation.
